title: Blog post front matter (content/posts/<slug>/index.md)
description: Matches the post format in AGENTS.md. Hugo reads these fields.

title.description: Plain title. Also used on the social card.

slug.description: kebab-case; becomes /posts/<slug>/. Do not change after publishing (add the old URL to aliases instead).

description.description: One sentence. Shown in lists and used as the search/social description (about 150-160 characters).

draft.description: Stays true until Jakub publishes (AGENTS.md, Rule 1).

image.description: Optional social/hero image, a file next to index.md. Without it a title card is generated.

aliases.description: Old URLs that should redirect here.
